description: changeVpsPaymentTerm: Stage a change of the payment term (billing cycle) for a VPS instance. Affects what you are billed. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.
